body:
Founder, worked from the cruise queue: 'we should have a weapon that is on like page 5 for 2.2k flow a trinket called luck of the draw that gives some mana regen during combat.' New ArenaItemDef.bonus_mp_regen_combat field (flat, matching the base ARENA_MP_REGEN_IN_COMBAT_PER_SEC rate's own flat-int shape), same trailing-field convention every prior trinket append (Haste Trinket, Kite String) already used. New cached ArenaHero.item_bonus_mp_regen_combat via arena_recompute_item_stats. In-combat mana-regen rate now reads base + item bonus, scoped to in-combat only per the founder's own 'during combat' framing -- verified by a real test that the bonus does not leak into the out-of-combat rate. ARENA_ITEM_COUNT 34->35, cost 2200 Flow. Real, honest scope note: at 35 items the shop computes to page 4, not the founder's literal 'page 5' -- treated as descriptive, not padded with filler items. New test (test_luck_of_the_draw_boosts_in_combat_mp_regen_only), scripts/test_arena.sh (1145 assertions) and test_10_bots.sh both green, scripts/build.sh clean. Real, live data-integrity issue found and fixed along the way: the kanban card carrying this ask had backlog_item_id S205-87, already a real, different, existing item (duck smoke bomb slow) -- a collision predating S235-01's own same-day fix. Given this work its own correct id S242-01, card's own backlog_item_id updated to match via direct reconciliation (no rename API exists yet), S205-87's real original item untouched. REDGARDEN commit 3d3f560.

⚓ ☃
title: S242-01: new Luck of the Draw trinket, +1 flat mp/sec regen in combat
